message:
The other day, I was reminiscing about the time my phone decided to die right before a big storm rolled in. I felt like I was in a real-life episode of a survival show—except I didn't have any cameras documenting my adventure! 

In moments like that, it's good to have a plan that doesn’t rely solely on technology. I found a great resource that helps with preparing for storms and hurricanes, just in case Mother Nature decides to throw a tantrum. 

Having a solid plan can save you a lot of stress down the road, even if your phone decides to take a nap. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared during storm season? 🌧️
